<!-- Report vulnerabilities and accidental disclosures privately using this
repository's SECURITY policy. Public issues must contain no private repository
names/code/findings. Use approved internal channels for private context. Never
include credentials, protected evaluation material, or raw/customer traces. -->

## Observed and expected behavior

Describe what happened, what you expected, and the affected component.

## Reproduction

Provide the repository revision, runtime, exact steps, and a minimal synthetic
example. Use synthetic or approved redacted inputs appropriate to the target
repository's visibility. Do not run paid/model
workloads merely to fill in this report.

## Validation already performed

List commands and outcomes, or state that no checks were run and why.

## Scope

Describe the impact and any known workaround. Link related public issues.
